target.statement: Auto-GLOSH achieves Precision@n = 1.0 on the Banana dataset with global outliers (Table IV, row Banana, column Auto-GLOSH, subcolumn G).
target.dataset: Banana (synthetic 2D dataset from Koncar 2018, with synthetic global outliers)

compute.basis: No code is released; the agent must reimplement HDBSCAN* with GLOSH, the CORE-SG multi-minpts hierarchy extraction, Auto-GLOSH elbow detection, and the synthetic outlier generation, then run on a tiny 2D dataset; most time is implementation and debugging, not compute.

blockers: No code released (no repository or supplementary code linked)
CORE-SG efficient multi-minpts hierarchy extraction must be reimplemented from the cited paper [8]
Synthetic outlier generation (GMM-based local/clumps, uniform global with Tomek-link filtering) must be reimplemented from description
Exact random seeds and data splits for the Banana dataset are not specified
title: Unsupervised Parameter-free Outlier Detection using HDBSCAN* Outlier Profiles
